$comment: Publishing pipeline config. `npm run snapshot` copies the vault into snapshots/<ts>/ (markdown only). `npm run ingest` extracts opencode + antigravity candidates into reviews/src/. `npm run classify` normalizes + routes snapshot + ingest into reviews/<ts>/<section>/ + MANIFEST.md. The owner edits MANIFEST.md, then `npm run promote` copies approved entries into src/content/<section>/. The vault itself is never read directly by the build.
